# Onyx Reelz

> Onyx Reelz is an AI video editor and AI video maker: multi-track editing, AI voiceover, captions, AI video generation (Kling, Seedance, Wan, Veo), avatar presenters, AI music, and one-click auto-posting to Instagram, YouTube, and LinkedIn.

Free to use, no card required. Credits (never expire) pay for AI generation, premium voiceover, avatar presenters, music, and clean/watermark-free downloads. Optional $15/month add-ons: Unlimited Brands, Auto-posting.

## Product

- [Homepage](https://onyx-reelz.com/): what Onyx Reelz does and who it's for
- [Pricing](https://onyx-reelz.com/pricing): free tier, credit packs, and add-on pricing
- [Support & FAQ](https://onyx-reelz.com/support): setup, features, billing, and troubleshooting
